label: Asymmetry of the fixed grade on NECESSARY_2 candidates selected by the profile classifier
definition: If each of a and b satisfies the supplied concreteness classifier and exists at every world accessible from w, then MoreIn esse a b excludes MoreIn esse b a. The comparison has no world parameter.
note: Analyst restriction of grade asymmetry to the given rigid necessary candidates. The supplied classifier and comparative need separate interpretation. Reverse comparisons and loops violate asymmetry; arbitrarily long or infinite nonreversing sequences can satisfy it. An ordinary strict numerical grade instantiates the structure. Application to existential grounding still requires a separately warranted ascent premise.
